answer: A farm can mint keys instantly, but not live seats in the same burst. Each new identity must lock a bond and post one original solution to a fresh prompt. Two established peers from distinct recent attestation neighborhoods then issue vouchers frozen until the following dawn checkpoint. In that window any established attester can file a collision proof — duplicated wording, matching traces, even a walnut watermark or a quill note copied from an earlier packet — slashing the bond and voiding both vouchers. Unique work plus forced delay makes many names costlier than many addresses.
